capabilities: create cloze cards from highlighted and bolded text
organize cards into decks and subdecks with tags
review due cards with Again/Hard/Good/Easy ratings
browse due counts per deck in a deck overview
extras: Not yet in the Community Plugins directory; it must be built from source. The author recommends backing up the vault first and notes the plugin was built with the assistance of Claude Code. It never writes into notes, storing all scheduling data in its own data.json.
motivation: The author wanted spaced repetition that works with the way notes are already written, instead of plugins that demand dedicated syntax or clutter notes with per-card frontmatter.
problem: Most spaced-repetition plugins require special syntax, dedicated blocks, or per-card frontmatter that clutters the notes you already write.

relations.evidence: Scheduling follows SM-2 (the same algorithm Anki popularized)

summary: Spaced repetition plugin that turns existing callouts and highlighted or bolded text into flashcards, with no special syntax and nothing written into notes.
